name: com.origuma.easyshader-core
description: Shared foundation for EasyPBR and EasyToon: common HLSL library (BRDF / effects / URP shadow sampling), map bakers (AO / Bent Normal / Shade Normal / Cavity / Curvature / SSS / Hair Flow / Face SDF) and ShaderGUI building blocks. Not intended to be used on its own - install it as a dependency of EasyPBR / EasyToon.
